standards.title: ML-KEM: Module-Lattice-Based Key-Encapsulation Mechanism Standard
standards.notes: Replaces classical public-key key establishment (RSA, ECDH, DH) for post-quantum security.

standards.title: ML-DSA: Module-Lattice-Based Digital Signature Standard
standards.notes: Replaces RSA, ECDSA, and EdDSA for post-quantum digital signatures.

standards.title: SLH-DSA: Stateless Hash-Based Digital Signature Standard
standards.notes: Conservative alternative to ML-DSA using hash-based approach.

standards.title: Transition to Post-Quantum Cryptography Standards
standards.notes: Provides timeline and guidance for deprecating classical algorithms and transitioning to PQC.

standards.title: Post-Quantum Cryptography Initiative
standards.notes: CISA guidance on preparing federal systems for PQC transition.

standards.title: OWASP Top 10 - A02:2021 Cryptographic Failures
standards.notes: Guidance on avoiding cryptographic failures in web applications.

shors_algorithm.description: Shor's algorithm can efficiently solve the integer factorization problem and the discrete logarithm problem on a sufficiently capable quantum computer.

grovers_algorithm.description: Grover's algorithm provides a quadratic speedup for searching unstructured databases, effectively halving symmetric key lengths.
grovers_algorithm.impact_on_symmetric: Reduces AES-256 to 128-bit security, AES-128 to 64-bit. Does not break AES-256.
grovers_algorithm.impact_on_hashing: Affects preimage resistance by square root factor. Collision resistance of SHA-256 remains at 128-bit.
